fields.definition: A data method whose results are hydrated into models automatically by the `Mapper`, as opposed to a `QueryAsync` method, which takes a caller-written result handler delegate. There are three families: `MapReader*` builds the root model from a single-row data reader result; `MapOutput*` builds it from output parameters; and `MapList*` returns one model per row. `MapReader` and `MapOutput` can also populate up to eight child list properties (`TReaderResult0`–`TReaderResult7`) from subsequent result sets. On a shard set, the `First` and `All` suffixes select `ReadFirst` or `ReadAll` fan-out semantics.
fields.name: Map method
